agendas.name: Malicious Hunt
agendas.description: Pre-game: the highest-Wounds enemy unit (excluding Transports) is your Prey. If destroyed by a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit, that unit gains 3XP. If the destroying unit is a War Dog, also gain +1 War Dog Domination level.

agendas.name: Tear Down the False Gods
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent places 3 Sacred Sites (objectives). When you control and desecrate a Sacred Site, select a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit in range for 2XP. If 2+ sites are desecrated, gain +1 Dark Gods level.

agendas.name: Seize Riches
agendas.description: Each time a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit destroys an enemy unit within 6" that has an Enhancement or Relic, the destroying unit gains 2XP and +1 tech-trophy. If 2+ tech-trophies are collected, gain +1 Idolators Influence level.

agendas.name: Tyrannical Domination
agendas.description: Rounds 3-5: for each non-deployment controlled objective, select a TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit in range for 1XP. Post-game: your Warlord gains XP equal to the number of non-deployment objectives you control.
